task: Desktop CLI session and source editor resource review

resource_risks.description: CLI sessions spawn child processes that can hang or remain running.
resource_risks.mitigation: Sessions are allowlisted, have a timeout, support cancel, and kill/wait the child on timeout or cancel.

resource_risks.description: stdout/stderr output can grow without bound.
resource_risks.mitigation: Session output is captured into bounded buffers with truncation flags.

resource_risks.description: stdin writes can send large or unintended input to an adapter.
resource_risks.mitigation: stdin and initial prompt inputs are bounded by MAX_SESSION_INPUT_BYTES and limited to allowlisted sessions.

resource_risks.description: Source editing can write outside the intended workspace or overwrite files without rollback.
resource_risks.mitigation: File commands require workspace-relative paths, deny protected directories and symlink escapes, enforce max file size, and create backups before writing.

resource_risks.description: Deferred CLI questions write to a durable coordination file.
resource_risks.mitigation: The inbox path is resolved under the workspace root, checked against protected directories, parsed as JSON, and updated only through the decisions and decision_history arrays.

lifecycle_checks.create_path: start_cli_adapter_session spawns an allowlisted command with piped stdin/stdout/stderr
lifecycle_checks.cleanup_path: cancel_cli_adapter_session kills and waits; poll kills on timeout and drops stdin

lifecycle_checks.create_path: write_workspace_text_file reads the original file and writes a backup path before saving content
lifecycle_checks.cleanup_path: backup path is retained under platform-desktop-app/artifacts/source-editor-backups for manual rollback

lifecycle_checks.create_path: send_cli_adapter_defer_message detects question-like session output and appends open decisions plus decision_history entries
lifecycle_checks.cleanup_path: Future answer/resume workflow updates status; duplicate session prompt ids are skipped

notes: Reader threads are joined when finished during polling; Rust compile remains deferred until toolchain installation.
